analysis_plan.decision_rule: advance a response family only if same-task trajectories are nearest for at least three of four tasks and the evidence is not explained only by final predicates; action may pass without JVP, while JVP alone cannot override failed closed-loop action geometry
paired_responses: BDDL predicate change points as a partial stage proxy
analysis_plan.task_level_geometry: compare the two trajectories of each task against all cross-task trajectories after subtracting the frozen-source response
analysis_plan.temporal_selection: within each successful trajectory, split replans into eight ordered progress strata and select the maximum paired expert-source action disagreement in each stratum
analysis_plan.trajectory_requirement: all eight preregistered direct-expert rows must reproduce success; otherwise the panel is invalid rather than silently replacing rows

claim_boundary: This is a diagnostic successful-policy occupancy panel, not an unbiased method evaluation or a task dictionary.
